title: Sum of the first n numbers
objective: sum_to_n(n) should add up every whole number from 1 up to and including n.
expected: Return the total as an integer. For n of 0 or less, return 0.
constraints: Use a loop, not the n * (n + 1) / 2 formula.

advice.diagnosis: range(1, n) on line 4 stops before n, so the last number is never added.
advice.rationale: range excludes its end value. Using range(1, n + 1) includes n itself, and still gives an empty loop when n is 0 or negative.

prediction.question: After applying the suggested patch, what does sum_to_n(4) return?
